text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: latency-slo-burn for /v1/generate (prod, eu-west)
- alert: p95 > 400ms for 6m, p99 ~ 890ms
- route: redwood-api.prod
- affected: inference-hosting, tokenizer, kvcache

elena_oncall: acked — I'm on it. Assigning initial triage. @sam_ops @mira_sre please check hotpath metrics and autoscaler.

sam_ops: looking. seeing sustained queue depth on sidecar-proxy (eu-west) + increased GPU busy. Possible burst from a single customer chunking requests.

mira_sre: KV cache eviction spikes coinciding with tail-latency. I see many prefix cache misses for long-seq jobs. Could be a hotkey or tokenizer cold starts.

sam_ops: running quick checks: cpu/gpu util and autoscaler.

``` 
kubectl get hpa -n prod inference-pool-eu-west
kubectl top pods -n prod | egrep "inference|sidecar"
```

sam_ops: autoscaler healthy but scaling latency ~45s due to node provisioning. We have two pending nodes in queue.

mahmoud_pd: PagerDuty: incident noted. If SLO burn continues > 15m we'll escalate to tier2. Any immediate customer-facing impact?

elena_oncall: early indicators: a handful of customers showing elevated latencies (chat UX slow, some timeouts). No-wide customer outage yet. Logging an incident ticket: INC-2026-089.

mira_sre: stack logs show tokenizer cold-start warnings and repeated full KV cache evicts: "kvcache: evict_whole_prefix=1 count=312 in 2m" — looks like an eviction storm.

```
[2026-03-17T15:12:03Z] kvcache WARN evict_whole_prefix=1 key=usr:1001 seq=2048
[2026-03-17T15:12:07Z] tokenizer WARN cold-start seq_len=2048 model=gptx-8b
```

sam_ops: mitigation options:
- speed up node provisioning (increase provisioner concurrency) — temporary tweak applied
- spin up spare dedicated pool in eu-west
- short-term routing: failover ~10% traffic to eu-fallback region (eu-central)

elena_oncall: let's do the routing fallback first (gradual 10% -> 30%) and spin spare pool. @sam_ops can you run the rollout? I'll notify support to watch customer tickets.

sam_ops: starting rollout: traffic shift script
```
./infra/routing/shift-traffic --from redwood-api.prod/eu-west --to redwood-api.prod/eu-central --pct 10 --reason "p95 spike"
```

sam_ops: applied 10%. monitoring p95.

mira_sre: also bumping kvcache retention thresholds to reduce eviction churn (temp):
```
kvcache.set_config({"max_prefix_age_secs": 900, "evict_threshold": 0.85})
```

sam_ops: node pool request accepted; 3 spare pods coming up (approx 40s).

elena_oncall: update: after 10% shift p95 dropped from 480ms -> 410ms, p99 still ~820ms. Keep progressing to 30% if steady.

mahmoud_pd: noted. Will hold off tier2 unless burn persists. Please post customer impact summary for handoff.

sam_ops: moving to 30% now.

elena_oncall: support: please flag customers with >500ms errors to CX (send list). Also add a short note on status page if customer-observed timeouts rise.

mira_sre: kvcache tuning seems to have reduced eviction events. tokenizer cold warnings still present but less frequent — possibly a model churn with recent rollout.

sam_ops: spare pool healthy, tail latency decreasing. p95 ~ 380ms, p99 ~ 620ms after 30% shift + kvcache tweak.

elena_oncall: good. I'll keep monitoring for another 30m. If stable, we'll close PD alert as customer impact reduced. Prepare a short post-incident summary for rotation.

mahmoud_pd: acknowledged. I'll mark PD as acknowledged and hold for close. Escalation not needed now. :thumbsup:

sam_ops: follow-up actions (to-do):
- investigate client causing burst and rate-limit if appropriate
- analyze recent model deployment logs for tokenizer churn
- permanent kvcache tuning or prewarm strategy

mira_sre: I'll open a follow-up ticket for kvcache prewarm and a dashboard for prefix-miss alerts.

elena_oncall: handoff plan: I'm handing to @mira_sre for root cause & long-term fixes. I'll update incident ticket and add timeline.

mira_sre: taking over. ETA for RCA draft 24h. Will include timeline and mitigation recommendations.

elena_oncall: summary for handoff (short):
- incident: sustained p95/p99 latency spike in eu-west due to kvcache eviction storm + tokenizer cold-starts compounded by bursty client traffic
- immediate mitigations: traffic shift -> eu-central (30%), kvcache retention bump, spin spare pool
- impact: several customers saw slow responses/timeouts; no complete outage
- next steps: kvcache prewarm, slow-start deploy safeguards for tokenizer, investigate offending client and consider throttling

mahmoud_pd: thanks all. I'll track INC-2026-089 until RCA posted. Closing PD escalation unless we see regression.

elena_oncall: closing the active oncall thread, leaving handoff note in ticket. :white_check_mark:
